scope: Screen another open-source ACIS/SAB decoding path and refresh the current OCCT open-source-versus-commercial exchange boundary; refine existing external semantic and FreeCAD qualification gates without changing local implementation scope.

method.kind: Public package metadata, repository documentation, and official product documentation review
method.evidenceBoundary: Public-source review only. Package claims, mutable-main documentation, and official commercial-component descriptions are not runtime qualification, source-lineage proof, independent corpus proof, or local implementation evidence. No support claim or J status is changed.

evidence.topic: cadmpeg-codec-sat as a candidate bare-stream parser and IR projection
evidence.observed: The published 0.6.1 crate describes inspection and decode of bare ASM/ACIS SAT/SAB/SMT/SMB B-rep streams. The project format-support page scores the aggregate bare ASM/ACIS profile L1 while describing selected geometry transfer into its own CAD IR. The route is an inner-stream decoder, not a DWG/DXF document, AutoCAD AcDs index, or owner-association reader.
doesNotEstablish: execution or output behavior of the exact 0.6.1 artifact
source/dependency lineage independence from cq-acis or other ACIS projects
independent producer corpus or expected geometry oracle
general ACIS coverage, closed-solid validity, or native CAD acceptance
DWG AcDs framing, page extraction, record indexing, handle mapping, or entity ownership
evidence.planUse: Keep as an optional parser/IR candidate. Before crediting independence, pin the artifact and audit source/dependency lineage and exact profile. Use only a narrow scratch-generated analytic case with expected values authored separately; reject semantic promotion when shape-relevant records are unknown or intersect unresolved profile questions. Do not treat its IR as a second kernel or native-application gate.

evidence.topic: cadmpeg open questions and provenance limits
evidence.observed: The current mutable ASM open-items document records unresolved interpretation risks, including construction/cache ownership ambiguity, missing coedge-partner substitution, body-kind inference from edge-use counts, and pcurve interval tolerance. The project states clean-room/legal restrictions and separates ASM, codec, and IR crates in its workspace. These statements are useful admission leads, not proof of code-level independence or corpus provenance; the mutable-main document was not assumed to match the released 0.6.1 package.
doesNotEstablish: that each listed open item is present in release 0.6.1
that every output has those defects
that all format knowledge or test data are independently reproducible
that the implementation is unrelated to every existing parser at code level
evidence.planUse: Check the exact release source and applicable open-item status before selecting a profile. Treat a result affected by an unresolved semantic choice as diagnostic only. If lineage or provenance remains unknown, label it SAME_LINEAGE_OR_UNVERIFIED.

evidence.topic: Current OCCT component boundary for ACIS and DXF
evidence.observed: Current OCCT product pages identify SAT/SAB import/export and DXF import/export (including embedded ACIS bodies on the DXF route) as separately delivered commercial exchange components. The OCCT core repository identifies its LGPL-2.1 license with an exception. The component descriptions distinguish the inner ACIS reader from a reader for the containing application format and mention healing/approximation controls.
doesNotEstablish: that an ordinary OCCT or FreeCAD installation contains or is entitled to the commercial component
availability on any specific host or app package
any specific SAT/SAB profile, import result, or geometric correctness
that historical release-note references imply current free/core availability
evidence.planUse: At an optional composed gate, preflight the exact application/runtime version, module/component presence and entitlement, inner save profile, and healing/approximation settings. Keep this outside build and fast-test requirements; preserve stock FreeCAD's separately documented importer/converter profile.

implementationReadiness.optionalCandidate: cadmpeg-codec-sat 0.6.1; exact source/artifact identity and lineage check required
